title: Spring News Roundup: Second Milestone Releases of Boot, Framework, Data, Security, Integration
gist: Week of September 21, 2026 Spring roundup: second milestones of Spring Boot 4.2.0, Framework 7.1.0, Data 2026.1.0, Security 7.2.0 and others, plus first milestones of Spring AI 2.1.0 (with an OpenAI Responses API chat model) and Spring Cloud 2026.0.0 'Paddington'.

insights.claim: During the week of September 21, 2026 the Spring team shipped second milestone releases of Spring Boot, Batch, Security, AMQP, Integration, Data, Framework, Spring for GraphQL and Spring for Apache Kafka, plus first milestones of Spring AI, Spring Cloud, Spring Web Services and Spring LDAP.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Signals the Java Spring ecosystem is on track for its next coordinated release train.
insights.locator: There was a flurry of activity

insights.claim: Spring Cloud 2026.0.0, codenamed Paddington, reached its first milestone built on Spring Boot 4.2.0-M2, adding a PropertyPathNotifier interface for HTTP notification of configuration changes and refactoring forwarded-header filters to deny requests from untrusted proxies.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Security hardening of proxy header handling matters for enterprises running Spring microservices.
insights.locator: The first milestone release of Spring Cloud

insights.claim: Spring Boot 4.2.0-M2 adds a management.observations.conventions property to switch semantic conventions between Micrometer and OpenTelemetry.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: First-class OpenTelemetry conventions in Spring Boot reinforce OpenTelemetry as the default observability standard in enterprise Java.
insights.locator: The second milestone release of Spring Boot

insights.claim: Spring Web Services 5.1.0-M1 adds observability support by integrating with the Micrometer Observation API for metrics and tracing of web service exchanges.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Even legacy SOAP stacks are being instrumented, extending the addressable market for observability backends.
insights.locator: The first milestone release of Spring Web Services

insights.claim: Spring AI 2.1.0-M1 introduces a MessagePart interface to represent the parts of messages current models actually return, and an OpenAiResponsesChatModel class that talks to the OpenAI /v1/responses endpoint.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Mainstream enterprise Java frameworks are tracking OpenAI's newer Responses API, easing enterprise LLM adoption.
insights.locator: The first milestone release of Spring AI

insights.claim: Spring Data 2026.1.0-M2 adds initial compatibility with Hibernate ORM 8.0.0.Beta1 to support the upcoming Jakarta Persistence 4.0 specification while keeping a Jakarta Persistence 3.2 baseline, and refactors Redis JSON support with a new JsonOperations interface.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Indicates timing of the Jakarta Persistence 4.0 migration wave across enterprise Java.
insights.locator: The second milestone release of Spring Data

insights.claim: Spring for Apache Kafka 4.2.0-M2 supports JSpecify nullability annotations, and Spring Integration 7.2.0-M2 adds a KafkaShareMessageDrivenChannelAdapter inbound adapter.
insights.speaker: Michael Redlich
insights.so_what: Continued Kafka-centric investment keeps Spring tightly coupled to the Kafka streaming ecosystem.
insights.locator: The second milestone release of Spring for Apache Kafka
